howItWorks.title: From documents to audit-ready posture in four steps

step1.title: Bring your policies and evidence
step1.description: Upload what you already have — nothing needs reformatting first.

step2.title: The platform reads and grounds them
step2.description: Documents are parsed and indexed against the frameworks you select.

step3.title: Review coverage, gaps, and risk

step4.description: Close gaps and generate an audit-ready report with a clear sign-off trail.

frameworks.title: Built for the frameworks you're already held to
frameworks.description: Regional and international standards, mapped once and kept current.

humanDecides.title: A human always decides
humanDecides.description: The platform proposes, drafts, and analyzes — a qualified person on your team approves anything consequential, like a control sign-off or a risk acceptance.

q1.question: Does Rasheed replace our compliance team?
q1.answer: No. The platform is built as an assistant, not a replacement — it drafts, analyzes, and organizes work, but a qualified person on your team always reviews and approves anything consequential, like a policy publication or a risk acceptance.

q2.question: Where does the AI get its answers from?
q2.answer: Every answer is grounded in your own uploaded documents and the compliance framework text — never a general-purpose guess. If the platform doesn't have enough evidence to answer confidently, it tells you that instead of making something up.

q3.question: Is our data isolated from other organizations?
q3.answer: Yes. The platform is built multi-tenant from the ground up — every query, document, and AI retrieval is scoped strictly to your organization. Cross-tenant access isn't possible by design.

q4.question: How do we get started?
q4.answer: Sign in, upload a policy or piece of evidence, and select the frameworks you're measured against. Coverage, gaps, and grounded answers are available within minutes.

q5.question: Which document types can be analyzed?
q5.answer: Rasheed works with internal policies, procedures, risk registers, contracts, controls, evidence, and other governance and compliance documents.

q6.question: Does Rasheed support multiple frameworks and standards?
q6.answer: Yes — Rasheed helps align your policies and controls with frameworks and requirements such as ISO 27001, NCA ECC, PDPL, and other relevant standards.

formalize_org_structure.title: Formalize your organizational structure
formalize_org_structure.rationale: Your organizational structure isn't documented yet — a basic structure is the foundation everything else in governance builds on.

draft_foundational_policies.title: Draft foundational policies
draft_foundational_policies.rationale: Your policies are informal or unwritten — putting the basics in writing is usually the fastest way to reduce risk.

establish_risk_register.title: Establish a risk register
establish_risk_register.rationale: You don't yet have a record of the risks facing your organization — even a simple one changes how decisions get made.

plan_internal_audit_cadence.title: Plan a review cadence
plan_internal_audit_cadence.rationale: You're not currently reviewing your own practices — a light, regular check-in catches problems early.

designate_compliance_owner.title: Designate a compliance owner
designate_compliance_owner.rationale: No one is formally responsible for compliance yet — even part-time ownership makes a big difference.

review_personal_data_handling.title: Review how you handle personal data
review_personal_data_handling.rationale: You handle personal data — it's worth a focused look at how it's collected, stored, and protected.

adopt_technical_security_baseline.title: Adopt a baseline of technical security practices
adopt_technical_security_baseline.rationale: Your technology team doesn't have documented security practices yet — a baseline is a practical starting point.

implement_data_residency_controls.title: Implement data residency controls
implement_data_residency_controls.rationale: You don't yet control where customer data is physically stored — this matters for several regulatory frameworks.

confirm_basics_with_advisor.title: Confirm the basics with a GRC advisor
confirm_basics_with_advisor.rationale: We don't have quite enough information yet for a confident recommendation — a short conversation with an advisor will fill the gaps.

approve_foundational_policies.title: Approve the foundational policies
approve_foundational_policies.rationale: Your policies are written but not approved. An unapproved policy carries no authority — ISO 27001 §5.2 and NCA ECC 1-1 both require management approval before a policy is in force.

approve_org_structure.title: Approve the governance structure
approve_org_structure.rationale: The structure is documented but not approved, so roles and authorities are not yet formally assigned (ISO 27001 §5.3).

approve_risk_register.title: Approve the risk register
approve_risk_register.rationale: The register exists but is not approved, so accepted risks have no accountable owner and no formal acceptance.

approve_internal_audit_plan.title: Approve the internal audit plan
approve_internal_audit_plan.rationale: The audit plan is drafted but not approved. An unapproved plan gives an auditor no assurance that the programme is mandated (ISO 27001 §9.2).

confirm_regulatory_applicability.title: Confirm which regulations apply to you
confirm_regulatory_applicability.rationale: You serve government clients, which usually brings you into scope of national cybersecurity requirements (in KSA, NCA ECC). Confirming applicability and scope early prevents building a programme against the wrong framework.

schedule_policy_review.title: Schedule periodic policy review
schedule_policy_review.rationale: Your policies are approved but there is no review cycle. An approved policy that is never revisited goes stale (ISO 27001 §5.2, §9.3).

schedule_org_structure_review.title: Schedule periodic review of the governance structure
schedule_org_structure_review.rationale: Roles and authorities are approved but not reviewed on a cycle; they drift as the organization changes.

schedule_risk_register_review.title: Schedule periodic risk review
schedule_risk_register_review.rationale: The register is approved but not reviewed on a cycle. A risk register that is not revisited stops reflecting the real risk picture.

schedule_internal_audit_review.title: Put internal audit on a recurring cycle
schedule_internal_audit_review.rationale: The audit plan is approved but not recurring. ISO 27001 §9.2 expects audits at planned intervals, not once.

establish_governance_oversight_body.title: Establish a governance oversight body
establish_governance_oversight_body.rationale: No board or steering group currently owns governance decisions. An oversight body is what gives policies, risk acceptance and audit findings somewhere to be decided (ISO 27001 §5.1, §9.3).

align_with_sama_csf.title: Align with the SAMA Cyber Security Framework
align_with_sama_csf.rationale: You provide financial services, so SAMA's Cyber Security Framework applies to you. Map your current controls against it and close the differences.

establish_cross_border_transfer_safeguar.title: Put safeguards around personal data leaving the Kingdom
establish_cross_border_transfer_safeguar.rationale: You handle personal data that moves outside Saudi Arabia. PDPL restricts that transfer — document the legal basis and the safeguards before it continues.

harden_critical_infrastructure_controls.title: Raise your controls to critical-infrastructure level
harden_critical_infrastructure_controls.rationale: You operate critical infrastructure, which carries the heaviest obligations in the national regime. Your technical controls need to be assessed against that bar, not the general one.

establish_third_party_risk_management.title: Manage the risk in what you outsource
establish_third_party_risk_management.rationale: You rely on third parties for critical functions. The work moves out; the accountability doesn't — you need a way to assess and monitor those providers.

personal_data_without_policy.rationale: You handle personal data without a written policy governing how it's used — a common starting point for regulatory exposure.

gov_client_without_compliance_officer.rationale: You work with government clients but no one is formally responsible for compliance — this combination often draws early scrutiny.
